prompt: A single firework burst for a pixel art sports game, plays once, about 1.2 seconds. A bright white flash, then about 24 spark streaks fly outward in a full circle, droop slightly, and fade with small trailing sparks. Colours: only white to light grey, so the game can tint it in team colours. Transparent background, crisp pixels, about 96 pixels across, centred, no text.
message: Made a 1.2-second, one-shot burst on a transparent 96×96 canvas: a white flash, 24 outward spark streaks, slight droop, and tiny trailing sparks. Only white and light greys are used for team-colour tinting; sliders adjust streak count, droop, and trails.
